concepts.label: A：端正なR
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original Windows application icon concept for 'Redia', a calm personal research-and-development workspace for notes, references, ideas and planning. Minimal premium productivity software aesthetic, distinctive at small taskbar sizes, precise flat vector-like geometry, broad shapes, balanced negative space. A single rounded-square tile fills about 86% of a square canvas, centered straight-on. Transparent outside the tile. No written wordmark, captions, mockup scene, tiny details, atom or gear or lightbulb symbols, gradients, shadows, texture, bevels, 3D, or watermark. Design a beautifully proportioned bespoke capital R in warm white on a muted medium-blue tile (approximately #3479B9). Strong vertical stem, rounded rectangular upper bowl with one generous counter, confident diagonal leg. The diagonal leg has a subtle intentional gap from the bowl, giving a clean modular engineered character while the R remains instantly readable. Restrained, architectural, quietly confident.
